items.title: Full Legends Awaken card list now on the official English site
items.summary: The official English card database now lists all 164 Legends Awaken cards, four days before the 30 October release.

items.title: Card reveal: Tombat – Resonance of Shadows and Nox – One-Way Ticket (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: The official English account revealed Tombat – Resonance of Shadows and Nox – One-Way Ticket, both from Legends Awaken, which goes on sale on 30 October.

items.title: Card reveal: Shroomer Noct – Spores of the Void and Electric Medicine Workbench (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Shroomer Noct – Spores of the Void and the Electric Medicine Workbench were revealed for Legends Awaken, on sale 30 October.

items.title: Card reveal: Quivern Botan – Meadow's Grace and Refined Metal Axe (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Quivern Botan – Meadow's Grace and the Refined Metal Axe gear card were revealed for Legends Awaken, on sale 30 October.

items.title: Sleeve & Card Set Vol. 1 is out now
items.summary: Sleeve & Card Set Vol. 1 reached shops on 16 October with 75 Pal Sphere sleeves and ten cards, two of them parallel rares.

items.title: Card reveal: SSP Anubis – Noble Reaper and Orserk – Thunderclap Roar (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: The SSP versions of Anubis – Noble Reaper and Orserk – Thunderclap Roar were shown for Legends Awaken.

items.title: Card reveal: SSP Jetragon, Frostallion and Frostallion Noct (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: SSP versions of Jetragon – Legendary Guardian Dragon, Frostallion – Everlasting Rime and Frostallion Noct – Eternal Darkness were shown for Legends Awaken.

items.title: Special Set Zoe's Strategy goes on sale at events from 7 November
items.summary: Special Set Zoe's Strategy will be sold at selected events worldwide, starting at Masters League 26/27 in Kissimmee, Florida on 7 and 8 November.

items.title: Card reveal: Mammorest – Gaia Crusher and Beware of Mammorest Sign (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Mammorest – Gaia Crusher and the Beware of Mammorest Sign structure were revealed for Legends Awaken, on sale 30 October.

items.title: Errata notice for Swee – Hibernating Together (EBP02-034)
items.summary: An errata was issued for Swee – Hibernating Together, affecting both EBP02-034 and its SR version.

items.title: Card reveal: Pengullet – Locked and Loaded and Stun Baton (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Official English account reveals Pengullet – Locked and Loaded (EBP02-033, C) and Stun Baton (EBP02-043, Gear) for Booster Pack Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Important Announcement Regarding Legends Awaken Product Availability
items.summary: Official English account says demand for Booster Pack Legends Awaken has been very strong and a small portion of shipments to the USA and Europe will have a minor delay while the team works to expedite delivery, and the October 30, 2026 release date is unchanged.

items.title: Card reveal: Chillet Ignis – Ember-Clad Dragon and Arsox – Blazing Fury (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Official English account reveals Chillet Ignis – Ember-Clad Dragon (EBP02-004) and Arsox – Blazing Fury (EBP02-009) for Booster Pack Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Card reveal: Saya's Crescent Moon and Daedream – Blissful Dreams (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Official English account reveals Saya's Crescent Moon (EBP02-095) and Daedream – Blissful Dreams (EBP02-082) for Booster Pack Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Card reveal: Sweepa – Record Breaker, Swee – Hibernating Together and Sweepa Saddle (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Official English account reveals Sweepa – Record Breaker (EBP02-027), Swee – Hibernating Together (EBP02-034) and Sweepa Saddle (EBP02-045) for Booster Pack Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Card reveal: Marcus' Turf and Rocket Launcher (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Official English account reveals Marcus' Turf (EBP02-023, Event) and Rocket Launcher (EBP02-018, Gear) for Booster Pack Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Card reveal: Victor's Gambit and Axel's Gambit (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Official English account reveals Victor's Gambit and Axel's Gambit for Booster Pack Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Card reveal: Lifmunk – Hidden Power and Lifmunk's Submachine Gun (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Official English account reveals Lifmunk – Hidden Power (EBP02-056, U) and Lifmunk's Submachine Gun for Booster Pack Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Legends Awaken Release Tournament and new Shop Tournament prizes for November
items.summary: Official tournament stores each run one Legends Awaken Release Tournament, November 1 to 30, 2026 (Standard, 5-round Swiss, best of 1, decks have at least 10 Legends Awaken cards; entrants get an ESOUL-017 PR card and a champion playmat of Frostallion, Jetragon and Frostallion Noct); Bushi Navi registration opens October 10 at 8 AM PT, November Shop prizes switch to PR Card Pack Vol.2 (17 cards).

items.title: Palworld OCG sales projected to pass 11 million packs worldwide
items.summary: Bushiroad projects that combined worldwide sales of Booster Pack Dawn of Palpagos and Booster Pack Legends Awaken will surpass 11 million packs by early November 2026, while official demo sessions have passed 24,000 participants and Sleeve & Card Set Vol.1 and Legends Awaken go on sale October 16 and October 30.

items.title: Card reveal: Mau – Greed Beckons and Sibelyx – Silken Spinner (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Official English account reveals Mau – Greed Beckons (EBP02-080, U) and Sibelyx – Silken Spinner (EBP02-028, R) for Booster Pack Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Palworld OCG PR cards for BanG Dream! 13th☆LIVE concert attendees
items.summary: Attendees of Mugendai Mewtype's "DIMENSIONAL OVERLAP" DAY2 show at BanG Dream! 13th☆LIVE (October 11, 2026, Tokyo Garden Theater) each receive one random special Palworld OCG PR card; Palworld OCG also has merchandise and displays at the event (October 10–12).

items.title: Card reveal: Frostallion Saddle and Frostallion Noct Saddle (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Official English account reveals the Frostallion Saddle and Frostallion Noct Saddle cards for Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Masters League 26-27 Tokyo Autumn deck recipes published
items.summary: Official Japanese account publishes prize-winning deck recipes from the Masters League 26-27 Tokyo Autumn event held October 3, 2026.

items.summary: Official English account reveals two Event cards for Legends Awaken: Lily's Gambit (EBP02-071, RR, cost 5) and Zoe's Gambit (EBP02-094, RR, cost 6), on sale October 30, 2026.

items.summary: Official English account reveals Seed Machine Gun (EBP02-072, Event) and Eikthyrdeer – Warden of the Woods (EBP02-099) for Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Next Masters League Tokyo Autumn set for December 6, 2026
items.summary: Official Japanese account thanks Masters League Tokyo Autumn attendees and announces the next Tokyo Autumn event on December 6, 2026 at Akihabara Square.

items.title: Masters League 26-27 Tokyo Autumn results posted
items.summary: Official Japanese account posts Masters League 26-27 Tokyo Autumn block winners and podium results across A–F blocks.

items.summary: Official English account reveals Relaxaurus Lux – Party Time (EBP02-010) and Foxparks – Breathing Practice (EBP02-013) for Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Masters League 26-27 Tokyo Autumn underway
items.summary: Official Japanese account reports the first large Masters League 26-27 Tokyo Autumn event is underway, with merch and side events open to visitors.

items.title: Sleeve & Card Set Vol.1 launches in Japan
items.summary: Official Japanese account marks the October 2, 2026 JP release of Sleeve & Card Set Vol.1 and shows a Cattiva OSR physical card.

items.title: Card reveal: Faleris – Marcus' Soaring Wings (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Official English account reveals Faleris – Marcus' Soaring Wings (EBP02-003) for Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Palworld OCG at Lucca Comics & Games 2026
items.summary: Official English account announces a Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME booth with GameTrade at Lucca Comics & Games in Italy, October 28–November 1, 2026.

items.title: Follower Milestone Giveaway Campaign (30,000 followers)
items.summary: Official site launches a worldwide giveaway for hitting 30,000 cumulative followers, with Dawn of Palpagos and Legends Awaken booster boxes as prizes through October 30, 2026 PT.

items.summary: Official English account reveals Bristla – Regal Gaze (EBP02-011) and Beegarde – Faithful Honor (EBP02-055) for Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.summary: Official English account reveals Orserk – Thunderclap Roar (EBP02-001) and Flambelle – Feverish Tears (EBP02-007) for Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.

items.title: Card reveal: Sleeve & Card Set Vol.1 five exclusive cards
items.summary: Official English account shows the five exclusive Sleeve & Card Set Vol.1 card types (Grizzbolt, Chillet, Depresso, Cattiva, Quivern), with two random OSR parallels per set, on sale October 16, 2026.

items.title: Masters League 26-27 Kyoto deck recipes published
items.summary: Official Japanese account published prize-winning deck recipes from the Masters League 26-27 Kyoto event held September 22, 2026.

items.title: Card reveal: Selyne – Saya's Moonlit Beacon (Legends Awaken)
items.summary: Official English account reveals Selyne – Saya's Moonlit Beacon for Legends Awaken, on sale October 30, 2026.
